integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, IMAX science-fiction blockbuster, a tight close-up inside the cramped cockpit of a battered space fighter during a massive space battle. She grips the controls, turns her head toward the camera and screams with fierce urgency (S1): <d>[French] Bouclier !
